title: Driven Brands Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Driven Brands Holdings Inc. (DRVN), a Nasdaq-listed automotive services company, filed an 8-K disclosing a Nasdaq delisting notice due to delayed filing of its FY2025 Form 10-K. The company has until June 15, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with potential extension until October 12, 2026. The delay stems from an ongoing internal review of financial statements and identified material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting.
key_points: Nasdaq issued a notice on April 15, 2026 citing non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to delayed FY2025 Form 10-K filing
Company has 60 days (until June 15, 2026) to submit a compliance plan to Nasdaq
Nasdaq has discretion to grant compliance extension up to October 12, 2026
The delay is due to ongoing internal review of financial statements and evaluation of material weaknesses in internal controls
No immediate effect on listing or trading of common stock on Nasdaq Global Select Market
Company also disclosed expected Q4 2025, FY 2025, and Q1 2026 performance via press release
